entities.summary: Custio Clayton is a Canadian professional boxer who has held the WBA-NABA welterweight title since 2019. As an amateur he is a six-time Canadian national champion and represented Canada at 2 commonwealth games and the 2012 Olympics, where he reached the quarter-finals. He began boxing at the age of 9 with his uncle Gary Johnson.
